title: Isolation of small extracellular vesicles from cell culture supernatant
protocol: Seed MDA-MB-231 cells at a density of 5 x 10^6 cells per 150-mm plate in 20mL DMEM with 10% FBS and 1% AA.
Wash the plates using PBS after 24 hours.
Change the media to FBS-free, AA-free medium containing vehicle or 100µM SFX (final DMSO concentration: 0.1%).
Collect the cell culture supernatant (40mL) after another 24 hours.
Centrifuge at 300 x g, 4°C for 3 minutes and transfer the supernatants to a new tube.
Centrifuge at 2,500 x g, 4°C for 20 minutes and transfer the supernatants to a new tube.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g, 4°C for 30 minutes and transfer the supernatants to a new tube.
Filter the supernatants using 0.22 µm syringe filters and transfer them to Ultra-Clear tubes.
Ultracentrifuge at 120,000 x g, 4°C for 90 minutes.
Resuspend sEV pellets with 30mL PBS and ultracentrifuge again at 120,000 x g, 4°C for 90 minutes.
Remove the supernatants and add 1ml PBS to the resuspended pellet.
Seal the tube with parafilm and store at 4°C for 1 hour before resuspending the pellet.
Transfer the samples to e-tubes and analyze using nanosight (Samples were analyzed at camera level of 9 and detection threshold of 4).
